يتقاوى (form VI)

# يُتَقَاوَى (yutaqāwā) /ju.ta.qaː.waː/: third-person masculine singular non-past passive indicative/subjunctive of تَقَاوَى (taqāwā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
